label: GOD_4 exists from the direct-esse first root, grades to a maximum at being only
description: Sibling of the thirteen-input direct-esse route 72391d4d with STMT-GRADES-HAVE-A-MAXIMUM (6c27657f, every respect) replaced by its fixed-esse instance STMT-GRADES-TO-MAXIMUM-AT-BEING (e4e6b0cd); every other premise is the same statement. The old route applies grades only at esse, inside actualCore. necessaryFirst gives the same actual first root n; ExistingInActAt gives n esse; the existing maximumExistsOfExistingRoot, instantiated at the one-point respect type whose only respect is esse, gives a maximum in esse; maximumEqualsRoot identifies every maximum with n and the existing reducedDescription theorem names n as God through actuality-to-being, universal-source transfer, firstness, no-component remoteness and the retained nominal bridge. No premise is discharged; the old route is unchanged. Sense bridges: NECESSARY 11 to 2 and NONNECESSARY 1 to 2 cite excluded middle (ee4ab504), which carries both passages: necessaryActualRoot splits on NecessaryAt of the root by excluded middle, and contingentRootOfNonnecessary turns the nonnecessary horn into a contingent root (an accessible world of the frame lacking it) only with that hypothesis, as the NONNECESSARY disambiguation states. No WELL_FOUNDEDNESS or INTRINSIC bridge is needed: GroundAncestor occurs in no hypothesis or step, and since #1635 the definition_ids of 5c898d24 link only constants its Lean type uses, with INTRINSIC_2 alone (the type instantiates Trap's intrinsic parameter with the graph Source predicate, the source-backed application).
